## Details

### elektron-firmware-tool

C, MIT licence. Unpacks Elektron .syx firmware and repacks it as a valid file. Lists Analog Heat MKI, MKII and +FX among supported devices - currently the only Analog Heat-relevant tool we found. Forum listing: 113 stars, repo created 2026-07-22, "last commit 1 month ago" at the time of listing.

_Sources: forum mod list (mods.php?id=7), forum thread 8_

### Overtone

Python 3.11+ patcher (patcher/patch.py) that builds Overtone from the user's own OS 1.12 and only saves the result if it matches the tested build byte for byte; install via Elektron Transfer over USB. Adds machines SOPHIE, MACHINEDRUM, LOOP, THRU, per-track insert effects, envelope followers, two arpeggiators, parameter slides and GROOVE (replaces swing). 1.0.1 fixes installing an OS sent with Transfer while Overtone runs. About 160 checks per build in two emulators (digikit for the main OS, a SHARC emulator for the DSP program); author states 1.0.1 passes all of them, is played on a Digitone II and Transfer installs were checked on the unit. Opening Overtone projects on stock OS is untested. Recovery section is detailed (FUNC + TRIG 4, DIN MIDI, ~15 min). AGPL-3.0-or-later (includes dnfw), 5 commits. Related: dnfw, digikit, dn2-cfw, Schwung Sophie (MIT), and the author's digitone-2-modding-skill used with Claude Code.

_Sources: forum thread 90, GitHub README_

### DigiRust

macOS patcher, "experimental Digitone II tools", use at own risk. Features include drone latch and Perform Kit restoration (see docs/FEATURES.md in the repo). Creates a verified copy locally, never talks to the instrument.

_Sources: GitHub release v1.2.0_

### SYXGRID v2

Free browser-based pattern/sequence editor, not a firmware mod. Repo includes sysexmap/, a public reverse-engineered SysEx format map (CC BY 4.0): 45 mappings, map version 1.13.0, each with a confidence level (A = hardware-confirmed on a DN2: 23; B = corpus-confirmed by repo fixtures: 12; C = inherited, one value exercised: 9; D = unknown, do not rely: 1). Narrowed by bisection on 2026-09-08 against a Digitone II (OS 1.10E) and a Digitakt II. Not decoded: parameter locks, sound parameters (filter, amp, FX, LFO), synth machine choice. Needs the DN2 in SYSEX RECEIVE mode; Web MIDI needs Chromium over HTTPS or localhost (Chrome/Edge 152 break SysEx receive on macOS). App is AGPLv3 since v22.46 (MIT through v22.37). 6 commits.

_Sources: forum thread 43_

### digikit

Native Rust emulator that runs the ColdFire and SHARC+ firmware together, with front panel, display and audio, plus a web panel (WASM core), a Tauri desktop app, the patch toolchain "patchkit" (applies modules to the user's own .syx), a headless scenario runner with pinned PCM hashes, a control socket for patch injection and DSP/ColdFire analysis databases with Ghidra tooling. README caveats: the DSP "does not run in real time yet", the browser host is parked on branch wip/browser-host, "no patched firmware has been installed on a device", and recovery via the bootstrap menu is "not tested on hardware". patchkit refuses to change sections 2, 4 and 8. 982 commits, AGPL-3.0-or-later with extra section-7 terms (attribution, origin, names) in NOTICE; page shows 46 open issues. GitHub marks it as not a fork. The org ElekLabs has 2 public repos: digikit and a fork of js216/selache. Original author: the GitHub profile m-dwyer is named "Em D" (Melbourne), which is exactly the credit ElekLabs' NOTICE requires ("digikit by Em D"); Overtone credits digikit to "Em D" as well. The earlier repo m-dwyer/digikit (196 commits, 4 stars, GPL-2.0-or-later, README at the time: "no audio", last visible file HANDOVER-2026-09-16) shows no move/archive notice and does not mention ElekLabs. ElekLabs has no public members, so the pages themselves do not show who runs it; the maintainer (user of this repo) states that Em D develops in ElekLabs/digikit (2026-10-31, not verifiable on the pages). The licence changed from GPL-2.0-or-later to AGPL-3.0-or-later with extra terms. Treat both repos as one project line, ElekLabs/digikit being the current one. Mod READMEs that say "digikit's emulator" mean this project.

_Sources: GitHub README ElekLabs/digikit, GitHub README m-dwyer/digikit, lapin-list_

### digi-roll

Browser piano roll that writes patterns over SysEx. Digitakt II / Digitone II: full write path, hardware-verified ("built and tested on hardware 2026-08-09"). Per-trig condition writing not yet smoke-tested. Original Digitakt: project backup and pattern import only; Digitone I: live-record fallback. Not a firmware mod. 57 commits, licence not stated.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### dn2_firmware_explore

Tools to inspect, modify and rebuild Digitone firmware. README status table: recovery path proven on hardware, a patch confirmed on the instrument; open: own images stall at ~80% in the recovery path ("fix built, awaiting a test"), fourth LFO planned. AGPL-3.0-or-later, 269 commits.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### dn2-cfw

Public lab notebook: notes, tools and new effects, no Elektron firmware included. Seven builds run on real hardware per README; next: 3-band compressor, Space-Echo-style delay. Rule of the author: "nothing counts as working until it has run on my unit". 28 commits, GPL-2.0(-or-later).

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### Elektroid

Sample and SysEx manager. README device list includes Analog Heat MKI, MKII and +FX, Digitakt I and II, Digitone I/II/Keys, Syntakt (also Analog Four/Rytm/Keys, Model:Cycles/Samples, Monomachine MKII). GPL-3.0, 2,506 commits, 425 stars. No version/date visible.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### Overwitch

Multitrack Overbridge audio on Linux. Supports Overbridge 2 devices incl. Analog Heat, Heat MKII and Heat +FX, Digitakt I/II, Digitone I/II/Keys, Syntakt. Overbridge 1 devices (Analog Four MKI, Analog Keys, Rytm MKI) not supported. GPL-3.0, 671 commits.

_Sources: GitHub README, lapin-list_

### DN2 mk2 Mod (dn2mk2-firmware)

Adds Digitakt II sample machines (ONESHOT, WERP, STRETCH, REPITCH, GRID, SLICE) with sample browser and recorder, PERC (34 Machinedrum machines incl. TRX, EFM, GND, P-I), Monomachine voices (SID 6581, DPRO WAVE/DDRW/DENS, VO-6) and a CPU guard. Browser-based patcher builds from the user's own files ("nothing is uploaded") and saves only if the output sha256 matches a build that passed scripts/ship_gate.py. Hardware: README says verification is pending per version; FIRMWARE.md says nearly every v0.21-v0.33 entry was checked in emulators and "not seen on hardware yet". Main open problem: DSP time (heavy voices cut sound). Flashing a 1.12 unit takes it back to a 1.11 base, projects saved under the newer OS may not open. 1,491 commits, 8 stars, AGPL-3.0-or-later. FIRMWARE.md says built firmware is kept on the repo's `builds` branch (not main) - unlike most projects here, which only ship patchers; we link only to the repo and docs, not to builds. Withdrawn builds: v0.4-v0.7 (oversized image).

_Sources: GitHub README, FIRMWARE.md, patcher web page_

### digitone-2-modding-skill

Agent skill (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor; install with `npx skills add`) for developing Digitone II firmware mods: ColdFire MAIN OS patching in C, SHARC DSP audio code, verification in two emulators (digikit + a whole-DSP SHARC emulator), rebuild/re-sign/flash over USB. Encodes stock-firmware addresses, hook sites, the ColdFire-to-DSP frame format, free memory and "hardware rules the emulators cannot check, which each once silenced a real unit" (contents not yet read by us - see hardware/MINING.md). Examples: double_time (sequencer clock hook), track_trim (-6 dB on track 1). Needs Python 3.11+, dnfw, m68k GCC, digikit. MIT (digikit-derived files GPL-2.0), 2 commits, 10 stars. Overtone was built with it. Closest existing relative of this repo's hardware/ folder.

_Sources: GitHub README, Overtone README_

### coldfire-rs

Rust stack for ColdFire V4e (MCF5441x): toolchain (rustc_codegen_gcc + libgccjit for m68k-elf), runtime, PAC generated from an SVD, and an Embassy HAL (GPIO, PIT, INTC, eDMA, UART, DSPI, eSDHC eMMC block reads, SSI/I2S, USB OTG device mode). Not an emulator and not an Elektron mod: the README never mentions Elektron or digikit, the only link is the topic tag "digitakt". It is relevant here because digikit names the MCF54415 as the control CPU of Digitakt II (and the Digitone II is described as ColdFire too). Drivers were run on the author's own MCF54415 board. README: API is young and may change before 1.0. 33 commits, Apache-2.0 OR MIT. Same owner also has deluge-sdk (Synthstrom Deluge, out of scope). Org shows no public members; no relation to ElekLabs/Em D found.

_Sources: GitHub README, FirestormAudio profile page_

### elekloader (simonjohansson fork - Digitakt II / Digitone II support)

GitHub says forked from elekloader/elekloader (not irpina's repo); 173 commits, GPL-2.0-or-later, NOTICE covers digikit code. Per README: Digitakt II 1.17 experimental - whole builds and linkable mods with their own core work, core checked in digikit's emulator, a key-swap mod works on a unit. Digitone II 1.12 experimental - whole builds, linkable mods, SHARC (DSP) mods and selectable synth/filter mods work; UI events and remote input checked on a unit, sine variants ran ten-minute note sweeps plus limited project/effects checks. Analog Rytm MKII 1.74 linkable mods with own core, builds with the core work on a unit; Analog Four MKII 1.56 hook bus, mod storage, unused DDR and recovery checked on a unit. Issue #13 plans Digitone II control-side support modelled on the Digitakt II implementation (hash-based stock-file recognition, devices/digitakt_mk2.py profile). 22 open issues.

_Sources: GitHub README, GitHub issue 13, search 2026-10-31_

### digi-roll-studio

Native Rust desktop sequencer for Digitakt II, Digitone II and Analog Four, built from digi-roll. Writes to hardware: README recommends throwaway projects. Safe-write ceremony of five rules (re-read and back up the destination pattern first, OS build on an allowlist, user confirmation, change only needed bytes, read back and byte-compare). Gen-2 dump protocol (digis) vs gen-1 (Analog Four). +Drive file-write commands 0x57/0x58/0x59 hardware-verified for a single chunk only, not called by the app (writes above 16 KiB refused); 0x5A/0x5B/0x5C (move/copy/delete) not implemented. Protocol code ported from elk-herd (BSD-2, (c) mzero). Fixtures: 34 real .syx dumps. 124 commits, GPL-3.0-or-later. Not firmware modding. Windows/Linux write testing incomplete.

_Sources: GitHub README, search 2026-10-31_

### digitone-syx-toolkit

Python CLI (+ Tkinter GUI) to capture, replay, diff and hex-view SysEx, and to generate Digitone II PATTERN .syx from an empty template. README (Japanese) says Digitone II only. Hardware-validated: pattern-wide mode, tracks 1-8, steps 1-128, normal trigs, pitch, velocity, length (inherit/explicit/INF), tempo/speed/total steps, import/send. Not supported: chords, track-default rewriting, condition/probability/micro timing/retrig, non-destructive editing. Length encoding per README: inherit = 0xFF, explicit INF = 0x7F, finite 0x00..0x7E. 47 commits, licence not shown.

_Sources: GitHub README, SYXGRID README_

### selache (SHARC+ toolchain)

Open-source toolchain for SHARC+ DSP (assembler/C compiler), GPL-3.0. Named in the dn2mk2 and dn2-cfw docs as the way to build Digitone II DSP code; ElekLabs/selache is a fork updated 2026-10-30. Original repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: dn2mk2 README, ElekLabs org page_
